claims: Deportivo Cuenca defeated Santos 1-0 on April 8, 2026.
Deportivo Cuenca vs. Santos was the opening match of the Copa Sudamericana Group D.
The match took place at Alejandro Serrano Aguilar, Cuenca, Ecuador.
The match was part of the Copa Sudamericana Group Stage.
The decisive goal was a goal direct from a corner kick (Gol Olímpico).
The decisive goal occurred around the 60th minute.
The decisive goal resulted in an own goal by Santos goalkeeper Gabriel Brazão.
The game's only goal occurred when a corner was quickly delivered, hitting the post and then goalkeeper Gabriel Brazão before going in.
Neymar did not feature in the squad for the opener
